about_the_game:
Introducing the Krone Agriculture Equipment! Expand your hauling experience in American Truck Simulator with this DLC. The Krone Agriculture Equipment adds a fresh variety of cargo types, featuring cutting-edge machinery from Krone – a globally recognized leader in agricultural equipment.

Take on the essential role of supporting the farming industry by transporting high-performance machines used by both local farms and large-scale agricultural companies. Your deliveries will help fuel the growth of agriculture across America.

Add this upcoming expansion full of Krone Agriculture Equipment to your Steam wishlist!
